subject: access and manage db with web shiny app

messages.author: 0228493b8a8d6d89
messages.subject: access and manage db with web shiny app
parts:
Dear all,
I would like to develop web shiny app that allows me to save medical information for hospital workers.
It is interesting to have two kind of access: One for administration and one for exploring/loading.

There are two types of data: personal data (limited access) and medical measurement information.

The objective is make the interpretation of the medical data by plotting graphs.

I think SQLite is enough. I need maybe DBI or annotationDBI package.

The question is:

Is there a simple example of shiny app to access and manage SQL db?

Thanks
Karim
